additions.group: 小型・独立後学習・構造化ローカル検索計画
additions.reason_selected: Independent full-parameter search-plan specialization (C-600 continuation) of Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct, 1,543,714,304 BF16 parameters. English natural-language-to-typed document/filename/metadata/Outlook search plans, distinct from embedding/reranking and GUI agents. Private training corpus and intermediate checkpoints unavailable; exact trained BF16 cannot be recovered from base or ordinary quantization. Research-only.
additions.quality_positive: Publisher exact executed development results: 735/746 files, 217/240 synthetic mail, 952/986 overall; metadata 262/266 vs Gemma 4 31B 255/266. Private confirmation B v2.1 80/100 vs v2 66/100 (15 gained, 1 lost), one mailbox, not public replication. Publisher MLX release consistency regenerated 986 answers. No speed/cost claim.
additions.quality_negative: Gemma 4 31B 973/986 overall and 240/240 mail vs 952/986 and 217/240; two-file-case margin not superiority, unequal adaptation budgets, adaptive board, comparator runs are for preceding v2. App-assisted v2.1 735/746 vs v2 736/746. Historical inputs/executor unavailable, English only, possible missing constraints and sender/recipient errors. No independent held-out comparison, owner runtime or cross-backend parity.
additions.risk_and_alternative_assessment: Only authorized read-only search on synthetic/owner-authorized fixtures with independently validated query executor and access control. No autonomous execution, mail access, or safety-control evasion. KEEP incumbents.
additions.observed_access: Public ungated observed 2026-11-28; owner entitlement not inferred
additions.license_metadata: Apache-2.0 weights/config/tokenizer; MIT inference/training source; NOTICE excludes rights to private data/product code; owner acts and training data review unresolved
